prompt: The image is rendered as a pencil sketch with light color wash, capturing the gritty texture of a subway platform. On the far left, a woman in a yellow coat stands near the edge, her posture rigid as she clutches a leather briefcase tightly against her side. Next to her, a teenager in a blue hoodie leans casually against a tiled pillar, one foot propped up on the base while he stares blankly at the tracks. A brown dog sits patiently beside the teenager, its leash held loosely by the teen’s left hand, creating a quiet bond between them. In the center foreground, an elderly man in a gray suit sits on a wooden bench, his head bowed slightly as he reads a folded newspaper. Beside him on the same bench, a young girl in a pink dress swings her legs, looking up at the elderly man with curiosity. Standing directly in front of the bench, a businessman in a black suit checks his wristwatch, his expression anxious as he taps his foot impatiently. To the right of the businessman, a street musician in a torn jacket strums an acoustic guitar, his eyes closed in concentration. A small child in a red hat stands next to the musician, holding out a metal cup for donations, while the musician subtly nods toward the cup. Behind them, a couple shares a single umbrella despite the dry air, the man in a green shirt holding it over the woman in a white blouse who looks at him affectionately. Further back on the right, a cyclist in a helmet rests their bike against the wall, adjusting a strap on their backpack. Near the cyclist, a vendor in an apron arranges flowers in a bucket, handing a bouquet to a customer in a denim jacket. Above the vendor, a security camera hangs from the ceiling, its lens pointed downward. On the far right edge, a janitor in blue overalls pushes a mop bucket, ignoring the chaos around him. A stray cat hides under the bench near the janitor, peeking out with wide eyes. Hanging from the ceiling above the center are three fluorescent lights, two of which flicker faintly. A discarded coffee cup lies on the ground near the woman in the yellow coat. A graffiti tag marks the wall behind the musician. There is no train visible on the tracks. There is no sunlight streaming through windows. There is no digital advertising screen on the wall.
